CLM-MAT-0220.statement: At zero magnetic field, the ratio between the non-reciprocal and reciprocal part of resistivity in CoTa3S6 induced by non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order is approximately 3.1x10^-12 m^2/A.

extra_quotes: To experimentally investigate the non-reciprocal electron transport, we employed the second harmonic lock-in measurement technique[21] with the measurement configuration as shown in Figs. 2E and F.

First-principles calculations show that the non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order induces asymmetric band dispersions even without spin-orbit coupling, establishing the non-relativistic origin of the observed response.
